purpose: Define evidence and claim gates for an external cellular/RF benchmark before any future adapter is implemented.

transmitter_truth.minimum_evidence: Source coordinates with declared CRS and deterministic mapping to the observed cell.

transmitter_truth.requirement: Stable transmitter identity and serving-cell mapping
transmitter_truth.minimum_evidence: Stable cell/site identifier, source field definition, and observation-to-transmitter join coverage.
transmitter_truth.missing_state_policy: Quantity-only validation at most; no per-cell RF claim.

transmitter_truth.minimum_evidence: Height with reference point and provenance.
Azimuth with reference frame, accuracy, and sector mapping.
Separate tilt fields with explicit convention.
transmitter_truth.missing_state_policy: Tilt is unavailable; do not infer from a footprint.

transmitter_truth.requirement: Carrier frequency, band, and duplex direction
transmitter_truth.minimum_evidence: Frequency in Hz/MHz/GHz or a validated band-specific channel mapping, with raw value retained.
transmitter_truth.missing_state_policy: Keep frequency-specific results separate; no cross-band claim.

transmitter_truth.minimum_evidence: Bandwidth value and whether it is configured, occupied, or measurement resolution.
transmitter_truth.missing_state_policy: No receiver-noise or RSRP/SINR normalization claim that depends on bandwidth.

transmitter_truth.requirement: Conducted TX power or EIRP with reference plane
transmitter_truth.minimum_evidence: Power value plus semantics, antenna gain, feeder/system loss, and calibration/reference plane.
Absolute gain and supported pattern parameters or a traceable equivalent.
Technology plus carrier/resource/load/noise semantics sufficient for the declared quantity.

measurement_truth.minimum_evidence: Coordinates, CRS, and accuracy or uncertainty.
measurement_truth.missing_state_policy: No spatial residual or map claim.
No temporal stability or campaign holdout claim.

measurement_truth.minimum_evidence: Raw received_power, RSRP, RSRQ, SINR, RSSI, or path_loss field with units.
measurement_truth.missing_state_policy: Do not substitute a related radio metric.

measurement_truth.minimum_evidence: Definition, device/vendor semantics, and any reference-signal or averaging behavior.
Serving cell identity/PCI plus deterministic mapping to the transmitter table.
Per-observation detected neighbors and identities when the claim needs interference or handover context.
measurement_truth.missing_state_policy: Radio-quality and interference claims are closed.

measurement_truth.minimum_evidence: Raw channel/frequency fields with units and join semantics.
measurement_truth.missing_state_policy: Do not combine bands or infer a carrier from the transmitter table alone.

measurement_truth.requirement: Receiver, device, antenna, and calibration provenance
measurement_truth.minimum_evidence: Instrument/device identity, antenna chain, calibration/detection behavior, and correction status.
measurement_truth.missing_state_policy: Absolute received-power claims are closed; relative trends may remain conditional.

measurement_truth.minimum_evidence: Height in meters with measured/estimated/reference-point provenance.

measurement_truth.requirement: Sampling, aggregation, missingness, and censoring semantics
measurement_truth.minimum_evidence: Raw row meaning, sample interval, aggregation method, detection floor, and missing-value encoding.
measurement_truth.missing_state_policy: No uncertainty-aware summary or calibration claim.

environment_truth.minimum_evidence: Geometry/height source, CRS, resolution, and date.
environment_truth.missing_state_policy: LOS/NLOS stratification unavailable unless measured labels exist.

environment_truth.minimum_evidence: Terrain model or observation altitude with vertical datum.

environment_truth.requirement: Measured LOS/NLOS or reproducible classification inputs
environment_truth.minimum_evidence: Measured label or geometry inputs sufficient to recompute the label.
environment_truth.missing_state_policy: Report aggregate results only; do not label residuals LOS/NLOS.

environment_truth.requirement: Route, site, and campaign spatial split support
environment_truth.minimum_evidence: Stable route/site/session identifiers and enough independent spatial coverage.
Documented map layers or source classes joined to observations.

legal_and_access.minimum_evidence: Stable landing page and raw metadata/sample access.
Dataset-specific license covering intended analysis and redistribution of derived artifacts.
legal_and_access.missing_state_policy: No adapter or derived benchmark artifact.

legal_and_access.minimum_evidence: Terms allow local processing, citation, and required derived summaries.
Raw export or documented lossless representation; not screenshot-only or summary-only.
Version/release date, DOI or immutable commit, checksums where available.
Data dictionary, README, paper, or equivalent authoritative field definitions.

allows: inferred transmitter geometry when clearly labeled

no_go_conditions: Source is inaccessible or restricted at the raw-data level.
Source requires silently invented site, height, power, pattern, receiver, or serving-cell values.
A calibrated transmitter or receiver correction is presented as independent validation truth.
Carrier frequency, bandwidth, or ARFCN units cannot be reconciled.
Observed metric is substituted for another metric with different semantics.
The source has no lawful rights statement for the intended processing.
Results would alter canonical RF, inventory semantics, validation readiness, optimizer behavior, terrain behavior, or fingerprints.

readiness_classes.full_inventory_validation_candidate: Public, versioned, lawfully usable data with deterministic transmitter truth, complete RF semantics, exact measurement quantities, receiver provenance, and reproducible mapping.
readiness_classes.propagation_validation_candidate: Useful for frequency-specific or relative propagation/measurement validation, but one or more absolute transmitter fields or environment labels remain incomplete.
readiness_classes.quantity_validation_only: Useful for checking a measured quantity and its parsing/aggregation semantics, not for reconstructing a canonical transmitter inventory.
readiness_classes.rejected: Fails public-access, legal, exact-quantity, compatibility, provenance, or uncalibrated-truth gates.

audit_decision_rule: Do not select a benchmark by numeric score. Select only when the claim-specific gates are met; otherwise publish the blocker and keep 6B closed.
